text:
Jonas: Quick follow-up from the RFC — proposing a lightweight 'probe shim' that folds observability probes into the canary path and can trigger fallback autonomously. Thoughts?
Maya: Love the idea. Main concern: extra latency in probe path if shim runs synchronously.
Samir: Can shim be async? i.e., emit probe, but allow request to continue and if probe fails within window, trigger rollback/fallback?
Jonas: Yeah that's the idea. Two modes: passive observability (no impact) and active gating (can trigger fallback). Default off for gating.
Leah: From SRE POV we need deterministic decision boundary. How do we avoid noise spikes causing flip-flopping?
Maya: Use a short sliding window + hysteresis + minimum sample count. e.g., 30s window, min 50 probes, 3 sigma or a simple p-threshold.
Samir: What about interface between shim and the rollout controller? proto API? I'd prefer a minimal contract: ReportMetric(metric, window_start, window_end, numerator, denominator) and DecisionHook(variant_id) -> {fallback, hold, ignore}
Jonas: Agree. Keep it tiny. Proposed state transitions: HEALTHY -> PROBING -> DEGRADED -> FALLBACK. Probe failures move state; probe successes move back slowly.
Anya: Audit trail requirement: every decision must log deterministic inputs and resulting action. Also we need a trace-id passthrough for forensic traces.
Leah: +1 on trace-id. Also need a manual override from console (canary hold/force-fallback).
Samir: For signal fusion, do we want to accept external telemetry (real-user metrics) in the same decision surface or as a secondary signal? Risk of tying user metrics to unstable probes.
Maya: Secondary signal with weighted votes. Shim emits primary probe score; controller can ingest user metrics and apply weights.
Jonas: Config sketch:
```
probe_shim:
  mode: active  # passive | active
  window_s: 30
  min_samples: 50
  fail_rate_threshold: 0.07
  hysteresis: 0.02
  decision_endpoint: /api/v1/rollout/decision
```
Samir: Looks good. Need to define gRPC proto and a fallback reason enum.
Leah: Operational runbook notes: set safe-defaults -> active off, passive on. Alert on PROBING state, page on FALLBACK.
Anya: Security: ensure decision_endpoint auth with mTLS and audit logs encrypted with KMS.
infra-bot: deploy-bot started canary for refactor/probe-shim-testing (canary id c-2026-42)
Jonas: Plan for rollout: start in eng-sandbox as passive for 2 weeks, then enable active for internal services, then tenant opt-in. Gradual ramp.
Maya: Will add lightweight instrumentation hooks in runtime; also need backpressure: if shim stalls, it must timeout quickly (100ms) and count as probe failure.
Samir: Edge case: double-triggering when controller is slow; add idempotency token per probe window.
Leah: Also add a cooldown after fallback (e.g., 10min) before allowing auto-revert.
Jonas: OK action items: Maya - PR runtime shim + timeouts, Samir - proto + controller adapter, Anya - auth/audit plan, Leah - runbook + alert thresholds. I'll own the RFC follow-up doc.
Maya: I'll start a draft today. @Leah can you propose alert thresholds for SLOs?
Leah: Yep, will ping with numbers.
Samir: I'll mock the proto and post in this thread.
Jonas: Thanks all :rocket:
